adjudicated 2026-09-02 from source stability-base-reruns.yml:55-70: the job loops `./mvnw test ... || FAILURES=$((FAILURES+1))` N times by design (count input, default 50) and exits with the failure total — the tests DO fail the workflow at the end, but this is a deliberate repeated-rerun stability harness whose per-run failures are tolerated mid-loop; the retry-masking diagnosis holds for the intermediate runs (a flaky pass inside the loop is invisible), though the final gate is honest — flagged TP as a boundary case with the loop-level exit noted
